payload.reason: Propose zero-redundancy synchronous swap-in combining allocator-first loop and single-lock order-0 allocation in mm/swap_state.c
payload.hypothesis: In synchronous swap-in, reordering swapin_sync to call __swap_cache_alloc_folio first and omitting preliminary order-0 cluster lock in __swap_cache_alloc eliminates duplicate RCU lookup and halves cluster lock acquisitions on order-0 cold faults without reducing runtime safety. Reject if races fail validation, correctness fails, or latency does not improve beyond noise.

mechanism.claim: Cold synchronous swap-in paths avoid preliminary swap_cache_get_folio in swapin_sync and preliminary swap_cluster_lock_unpinned in __swap_cache_alloc for order-0 faults; locked post-allocation validation and -EEXIST cache lookup fallback remain authoritative.
mechanism.falsifier: Exact-tree review shows lost lifetime protection, incorrect slot conflict handling, or broken cache lookup fallback. Correctness, metadata spread <1%, and calibrated fast-tier screen independently gate execution.
